# Skill: documentation

## Use when

Use when adding or changing documentation
or public API comments.

## XML

Write XML documentation in en-US.
Fill every applicable field.

Use:

- `summary`
- `param`
- `typeparam`
- `returns`
- `remarks`
- `exception`
- `value`

Only include tags that are applicable to
the member.

Documentation must match implementation.
Do not document speculative behavior.

## Markdown

Keep architecture documentation close to
the repository structure.
Prefer concise normative language.
Keep examples consistent with the current
architecture.
